summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Anatomía Spanish anatomy study app. All 20 backend tests passed (100% success), covering topics CRUD/upload, PDF -> Claude Sonnet 4.5 MCQ generation, quiz flows (practice/exam/errors/favorites/srs modes), submit/stats increments, favorite & difficult toggles, question/topic deletion (with cascade), stats endpoints. Claude integration via emergentintegrations + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY works end-to-end and produces valid 3-option MCQs. No MongoDB _id leakage detected.

minor.issue: Endpoint takes ~15-25s per upload (Claude latency). Acceptable but front-end must show a loading state with long timeout.
Does not validate that question_id exists; unknown ids are silently skipped (correct/total can desync). Not breaking but consider returning info about ignored answers.
If req.answers is an empty list, total=0 and score_10=0; would still create an Attempt doc. Likely fine but worth a 400 to keep DB clean.
Topic is inserted BEFORE Claude is called and only rolled back on exception/empty result; if Claude returns valid but very few questions (<num_questions), no warning surfaces — currently acceptable.

action_items: None blocking. Optional hardening: validate question_id existence in /api/quiz/submit and reject empty answers list with 400.
Optional: add a /api/health route — current /api/ root works but a dedicated readiness endpoint helps supervisor checks.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~580 lines and OK for now; if features grow (auth, analytics) consider splitting into routers (topics.py, quiz.py, stats.py).
generate_questions_with_claude raises HTTPException(500) when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing — good. JSON parsing has fallback regex which is a nice safety net.

Topic deletion correctly cascades questions via separate delete_many. Attempts referencing deleted topics are NOT cascaded — they keep stale topic_ids which is acceptable history but may pollute stats by-topic if topic is later recreated with new id; current code matches on topic.id so it's fine.
Quiz start shuffles options and recomputes correct_index correctly — verified.
Quiz submit uses $inc for times_answered/times_correct and updates SRS via SM-2 simplified — works and persists.
All Mongo queries use projection {"_id":0} consistently; no ObjectId leakage observed in any response.
seed_data_creation: Tests created and cleaned up two temporary topics (TEST_Upload_Tronco, TEST_DeleteCascade) via /api/topics/upload + DELETE. Seed topic 'Huesos del tronco' remained intact. Some questions in the seed topic now have non-zero times_answered/times_correct from the submit test (expected side effect of testing the increment).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully verified via /app/backend/tests/test_anatomia_backend.py. To re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_anatomia_backend.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Total runtime ~45s (Claude calls dominate). PDF used: /tmp/tronco.pdf (15MB). The seed topic 'Huesos del tronco' is expected to exist. Frontend not yet tested.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA — all endpoints behave per spec.
